messages:
Maria (PM): quick sync — ACME wants a shorter autoscale cooldown (from 5m -> 60s) to avoid 2-3s tail latency on sustained surges. they say current cooldown causes visible UX blips.
Jun (Eng Lead): shorter cooldown helps latency but increases churn on reserved pools, more preemptions + warmup cost. we need guardrails.
Leo (SRE): agree. also worried about eviction storms. we should limit aggressive ramp-down to tenants with burst credits.
Sam (AE): ACME is willing to pay for a tighter SLA if we can promise <=100ms p95 under surges. they asked about how that maps to billing.
Maria (PM): flag: business wants both lower latency and predictable billing. can we propose a policy that trades off short cooldown with a billed "stability buffer"?
Jun (Eng Lead): rough idea: dual-path autoscale. short cooldown (60s) allowed only when tenant has >X% reserved pool commitment or has purchased a stability buffer. otherwise fallback to 5m.
Leo (SRE): +1. need telemetry surfaced: per-tenant ramp events, preempt counts, instance churn, and cost delta. tie alerts to churn threshold.
Jun (Eng Lead): example config prototype: \n```\nautoscale: \n  cooldown: 60s # conditional\n  conditional: \n    stability_buffer: required\n    min_reserved_commitment_pct: 40\n  fallback_cooldown: 300s\n```\nMaria (PM): nice. what are launch criteria? my proposal: (1) telemetry available in console per-tenant (2) regression <2% p95 overall, (3) billing statement for buffer clear in Console, (4) legal ok for SLA addon.
Sam (AE): sales needs clear customer-facing copy: what "stability buffer" buys you, pricing band, and upgrade flow. i'll draft with legal.
Leo (SRE): ops concerns: we must cap how many tenants can use short cooldown in a region simultaneously or risk noisy neighbor. suggest region-level admission control.
Jun (Eng Lead): admission control makes sense. also allow a time-windowed ramp for new adopters: 24h soft-mode where we monitor churn before full enable.
Maria (PM): risks: cost delta, preempt impact on other reserved pool customers, complexity in console UI. mitigation: pilot with 2 customers + canary flags.
Sam (AE): propose pilot with ACME + BetaRetail. ACME already asked; BetaRetail has predictable traffic.
ops-bot: deploy flag created -> feature/short-cooldown-gate (staged). canary group: region-us-west-1.
Leo (SRE): for observability, add metrics: \n- tenant.autoscale.ramp_count\n- tenant.autoscale.preemptions\n- tenant.instance_warm_time_ms\n- tenant.cost.delta_short_cooldown_usd\nMaria (PM): owners: Jun implements control plane + admission; Leo sets up dashboards/alerts; Sam owns pilot comms; i'll own launch criteria and product copy.
Jun (Eng Lead): estimated eng effort: 3w for control plane + 1w for admission caps + 1w testing -> 5w total.
Leo (SRE): infra/telemetry: 2w to add metrics & dashboards, plus 1w on-call prep.
Sam (AE): I'll line up ACME pilot kickoff this week if we can give a commit window.
Maria (PM): decision: greenlight pilot if eng + sres confirm ETA. Jun/Leo can you ok the timelines?
Jun (Eng Lead): ok. we hit 5w but can scope down for pilot: implement conditional cooldown and admission control (3w) + basic metrics (1w) -> 4w MVP.
Leo (SRE): i can do metrics in 2w and basic alerts. agree to 4w MVP.
Maria (PM): great. next steps: Jun make PR for flag + config proto, Leo create dashboard placeholders, Sam draft pilot contract language. update here when PR is ready. :thumbsup:
Sam (AE): noted, will circulate draft and confirm ACME kickoff on Friday.
Jun (Eng Lead): opening branch now: feature/short-cooldown-gate. pinging when PR is up.
Maria (PM): awesome — closing for now. will post a short kickoff agenda once Sam confirms pilot participants.
